description: Use Claude Sonnet 5.5 as the advisor your main model consults at decision points (before committing to an approach, on a recurring error, before declaring a task done). A lower-cost second opinion for Haiku, Sonnet and Opus up to 4.8 main models; Claude Code does not attach it to Opus 5 or later, or to Fable. Pinned to the full model ID, so it stays on 5.5. Requires Claude Code v2.1.287+ and the Anthropic API or Claude Platform on AWS; the advisor stays off when DISABLE_TELEMETRY or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC is set.
